en.title: Two entropy-sign errors in the proof of Proposition 1
en.problem_md: The statement uses +H. Its four-term difference equals $MI(X_i;Y\mid S)-MI(X_i;Y\mid S,X_j)$. The proof first negates this difference, then uses the opposite sign convention from Equation (7) for three-way information. The two errors cancel in the final formula. H(H|XS) is also a Y transcription typo.

title: Eq14/15把固定大小取整丢弃率换成连续比例
source_location: supplement PDF9 H definition; PDF10 Eqs.(14)–(15)
evidence_md: 原K均匀取固定大小k，不是Bernoulli dropout。取n=4、α=2/5、k=2、$g(S)=|S|$，所有pair交互0，真实均值2，原Eq14为$(1-α)4=12/5$。正确抽取包含率k/n仅可作为另一个修订推导，不能把它冒充原Eq14证明。

en.title: Equations (14)–(15) replace the rounded fixed-size rate
en.problem_md: The source samples a fixed-size subset uniformly, rather than using Bernoulli dropout. For n=4, α=2/5, k=2 and $g(S)=|S|$, all pair interactions vanish and the true mean is 2, whereas Equation (14) gives 12/5. The inclusion probability k/n belongs to a separate corrected derivation and does not prove the original equation.

en.problem_md: When all context differences vanish, both numerator and denominator are zero and the source gives no 0/0 convention. Ratio bounds and the same-sign equality apply only on the positive-denominator domain and do not make the original definition total.

title: Nullity显示量词与双玩家定义域
evidence_md: 原文字说other variables，但显示∀j∈N包含j=i。pair的原上下文大小范围n−2及两玩家解释要求i≠j；若硬扩成自配对，Δ(i,i,S)=g(S)−g(Si)，dummy增量非零时不为0。原量词照录，适配的i≠j是双玩家domain，不是补入以救自配对扩张。

en.title: The displayed nullity quantifier and the two-player domain
en.problem_md: The prose says other variables, while the display includes j=i. The source two-player interpretation and n−2 context range use distinct players. A literal self-pair extension gives Δ(i,i,S)=g(S)−g(Si), which is nonzero for a nonzero dummy increment. The displayed quantifier is retained; the adapter’s distinct-player premise records the pair domain rather than proving the self-pair extension.
